title: AI rollout fail kyun hota hai
content:
[HOOK: face to camera, serious]
SOME companies are pulling back on AI.
Here's WHY.

[SCREEN: X trending - Companies pull back on AI after costly errors | Oct 16, 2026]
X pe is hafte ye bada discussion chal raha hai.
Rushed AI rollouts... aur phir mistakes fix karne mein ghante.

[CAM: face]
Problem AI nahi hai.
The problem is HOW it was rolled out.
Teen galtiyan main baar baar dekhta hoon.

[GRAPHIC: 1. Everything at once]
Number one. Sab kuch EK saath automate.
Start with one boring task. Bas ek.

[GRAPHIC: 2. No human check]
Number two. Koi human check nahi.
AI draft kare... insaan APPROVE kare.

[GRAPHIC: 3. No measurement]
Number three. Koi measurement nahi.
Pehle din se track karo... kitna time bacha?

[CAM: close-up]
Small start. Human in the loop. Clear numbers.
That is how AI actually sticks in a business.

[CTA]
Aapke business mein AI sahi tarike se lagana hai?
DM me 'AI'.
